component.title: AlertDialog
component.purpose: Make consequential decisions explicit, recoverable, and resistant to accidental dismissal.

states.description: A destructive confirmation with clear impact and explicit actions.
A disabled action surface while a consequential request is in flight.
A useful error that preserves work and offers a retry path.

responsive.mobile: The dialog becomes a bottom sheet with full-width actions.

keyboard: Tab remains contained inside the alert dialog
Escape and outside clicks do not dismiss a consequential decision
semantics: The alertdialog has a title and persistent description
Request errors are announced as alerts

reducedMotion: The restrained entrance transition is disabled when reduced motion is preferred.
